verdict.finding: the three numerators 17, 5, -1 are m_k = 3k^2 - 21k + 35 = 7(21 B_2(k/7) + 3/2)/7, and B_2 is the Fourier signature of Li_2 at roots of unity (Re Li2(zeta_7^k) = pi^2 B_2(k/7)). So the target is the single relation Re[2L(w_k)+L(-w_k)] = (7/2) Re Li2(zeta_7^k) + pi^2/4 with w_k = zeta_7^k + zeta_7^-k + 1.
verdict.why_it_helps: Re Li2(zeta_7^k) = pi^2 B_2(k/7) is elementary -- the cosine Fourier series of B_2 -- needing only real analysis and Cl_2, NOT the complex Li_2 continuation that blocks qou-clx8/qou-ph1k. The corpus already has Cl_2 from #4666. And it replaces three fitted-looking integers with a named classical object (Kubert / multiplication relations).
verdict.still_open: the distribution relation itself is verified, not derived.
